Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by the Fed's "disturbing" inflation comments and hints of more rate hikes. This directly impacts your tech and chip names, which are sensitive to higher rates and economic slowdowns.

Your holdings: SOXL (-75.06%), MUU (-59.4%), and SPAL (-42.98%) are bleeding heavily, amplified by their leveraged nature. SMCI (-36.67%) also needs attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on further Fed commentary and any signs of global economic slowdown, especially from China, which could affect chip demand.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, losing positions in this hawkish environment.
plays: Review SOXL, MUU, SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are far past their stops and deep in the red. Consider cutting losses to preserve capital.
Trim CRWD: Take some profits on this +29.06% winner to reduce tech concentration and free up cash.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market mood is too uncertain with the Fed's hawkish comments.
